title: Practice 1: до-: as far as, reaching

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.why: **довели** — past tense (plural) of довести: perfective (imperfective partner: доводить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).
exercises.prompt: We made him cry.

exercises.why: **довела** — past tense (feminine) of довести: perfective (imperfective partner: доводить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).
exercises.prompt: She made her cry.

exercises.why: **доводи** — imperative (ты, singular) of доводить: imperfective (perfective partner: довести).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).
exercises.prompt: Don't make me cry.

exercises.why: **доедем** — future tense (1st person plural) of доехать: perfective (imperfective partner: доезжать).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).
exercises.prompt: Is this the right way to the museum?

exercises.why: **донести** — infinitive, perfective (imperfective partner: доносить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).
exercises.prompt: I've decided to tell on Tom.

exercises.prompt: Bring the water to a boil.

exercises.prompt: She gave me a ride home.

exercises.q: Это письмо не ___ (дойти / доходить) до адресата.
exercises.why: **дойдёт** — future tense (3rd person singular) of дойти: perfective (imperfective partner: доходить).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).
exercises.prompt: This letter won't reach its destination.

exercises.q: На каком поезде мы ___ (доехать / доезжать) до Камакуры?
exercises.why: **доедем** — future tense (1st person plural) of доехать: perfective (imperfective partner: доезжать).  Prefix **до-**: reaching a limit or destination (до + gen).
